1:00020.name: inittimer
1:00020.evidence: Programs PIT ports 43h/40h and installs 1:002a0 as interrupt 08h. Main inlines the same sequence.

1:00080.name: uninittimer
1:00080.evidence: Reprograms the PIT with an all-ones divisor and restores the old interrupt 08h vector. gameexit inlines this operation.

1:00290.name: level_load_hook
1:00290.evidence: Empty public called twice by enterlevel around loading the board. Descriptive name.

1:002a0.name: timerhandler
1:002a0.evidence: IRQ0 vector installed at 05c32. Interrupt save/restore, totalclock increment, keyboard input processing and PIC acknowledgement.

1:00c60.name: gameexit
1:00c60.evidence: Common fatal-exit path reached with error strings. Shuts down active audio and networking, restores timer and text mode, then exits.

1:00d10.name: domovethings_multiplayer
1:00d10.evidence: Processes network input and advances the same ordered series of simulation updates as 08ea0. Descriptive suffix.

1:01120.name: moveloop
1:01120.evidence: Coordinates recording and playback with packet processing, getinput and the simulation tick at 08ea0.

1:023d0.name: next_text_shade
1:023d0.evidence: Advances a phase by 128 and returns 16 plus sine divided by 1024. Score and name-entry callers use it as a text shade.

1:02400.name: operatefta
1:02400.evidence: HUD renderer draws strings from the 32-byte quote table, controlled by player quote ID/countdown fields set by FTA.

1:02630.name: FTA
1:02630.evidence: Schedules a player quote by ID, sets display duration from strlen and checks a user option. Compare GAME.C FTA and operatefta.

1:026c0.name: cameratext
1:026c0.evidence: Draws tile-based overlays based on player camera state and viewing fields. Called after room rendering.

1:02750.name: gametext
1:02750.evidence: Translates digits and letters to glyph tiles and calls the tile blitter for each character of a passed string.

1:02850.name: gametext_layout
1:02850.evidence: Related glyph loop computes string widths and line positions. Used by bonus and level-transition screens.

1:02a40.name: strget
1:02a40.evidence: Text-entry loop reads keystatus, selects shifted/unshifted scan-code table, edits a caller buffer and renders glyphs.

1:02e40.name: LocateTheLocator
1:02e40.evidence: Walks headspritestat[4], tests hitag and optional sector, and returns a matching sprite or -1. Matches the later GAME.C search structure.

1:02e90.name: EGS
1:02e90.evidence: Many-argument raw sprite construction via insertsprite. Initializes packed sprite and per-sprite game metadata fields.

1:02fb0.name: cacheit
1:02fb0.evidence: Level-load tile precache selects tile ID runs and calls loadtile based on the tile-cache state. PREMAP.C counterpart.

1:03760.name: genspriteremaps
1:03760.evidence: Reads LOOKUP.DAT count and 256-byte remaps, calling the engine palette-lookup builder. PREMAP.C counterpart.

1:03800.name: draw_loading_screen
1:03800.evidence: Called by enterlevel on either side of board I/O and draws text and tiles using the shared scratch buffer.

1:03a20.name: animatesprites
1:03a20.evidence: Camera-relative render-sprite processing dispatches by tile ID and CON actor pointer. Several drawing paths inline a related block.

1:03f50.name: draw_water_distortion
1:03f50.evidence: Transforms a rectangular framebuffer region with 320-byte row stride and a filtered palette ramp. Called by displayrooms.

1:04050.name: displayrooms
1:04050.evidence: Builds a view from player/sprite data, calls engine drawrooms 33f18 and runs subsequent sprite/mask rendering.

1:04cd0.name: nonsharedkeys
1:04cd0.evidence: Handles local scancodes, toggles music and sound, calls screencapture and displays warp mode strings.

1:054f0.name: comlinehelp
1:054f0.evidence: Prints the usage banner and switch descriptions. Compare GAME.C.

1:05570.name: checkcommandline
1:05570.evidence: Parses switches, handles unknown-option strings, starts demo recording and branches into map encode mode.

1:05b60.name: main
1:05b60.evidence: Direct call from bound Watcom __CMain at 6477d. Game startup messages, initialization and outer loop.

1:07890.name: playback
1:07890.evidence: Demo loop uses loaded input streams, calls simulation/rendering and opens another demo at interval boundaries.

1:08e30.name: record
1:08e30.evidence: Copies one player's current signed-byte motion inputs, command bits and timing byte into five demo streams and clamps count at 16383.

1:08ea0.name: domovethings
1:08ea0.evidence: Advances tick counters, records input and runs player, animation, sector and sprite status updates in the main loop.

1:09650.name: dobonus
1:09650.evidence: BONUS, space-to-continue, secret and enemy tally messages. Called during level transition.

1:0a6f0.name: update_menu_cursor
1:0a6f0.evidence: Reads getmousevalues and updates shared menu cursor fields before drawing.

1:0a8b0.name: displayhighscores
1:0a8b0.evidence: Formats player records and draws Hero's Quote and Score headings.

1:0b520.name: read_userdefs
1:0b520.evidence: Reads USERDEFS.TMP in 21, 396 and 48 byte blocks and supplies defaults when open fails.

1:0b5d0.name: write_userdefs
1:0b5d0.evidence: Writes the same three USERDEFS.TMP blocks as read_userdefs.

1:0b630.name: saveplayer
1:0b630.evidence: Formats SAVE filenames, writes a save header and calls the engine saveboard routine at 39337.

1:0b700.name: loadplayer
1:0b700.evidence: Reads the save header, calls loadboard at 39127 and reports missing boards.

1:0b810.name: read_demo
1:0b810.evidence: Opens numbered MYDEMO file, reads three newgame settings, 32-bit count and five input streams.

1:0b920.name: write_demo
1:0b920.evidence: Writes three newgame settings, 32-bit count and parallel demo input streams to a generated filename.

1:0ba30.name: moveeffectors
1:0ba30.evidence: Walks early status 4 and dispatches on sprite lotag, manipulating walls, floors, ceilings and moving-sector companions. Compare ACTORS.C moveeffectors, whose status number differs.

1:0f160.name: spawn
1:0f160.evidence: Uses EGS for new sprites, switches on tile IDs and initializes matching sprite/hittype fields. A separate path initializes existing map sprites.

1:11380.name: draw_camera_view
1:11380.evidence: Redirects the framebuffer, invokes engine drawrooms with a sprite-relative camera and draws mask/render overlays.

1:11a10.name: update_viewscreens
1:11a10.evidence: Gathers positions from map walls and references camera-view tile storage before drawing rooms and masks.

1:11de0.name: resetpspritevars
1:11de0.evidence: Resets or initializes packed per-player fields and sprites during level setup.

1:12210.name: prelevel
1:12210.evidence: Runs from enterlevel after loadboard. Initializes map sprites and sector effects, precaches tiles, populates animwall and emits its overflow diagnostic.

1:148a0.name: newgame
1:148a0.evidence: Receives volume, level and skill from the demo header or menu, saves them and resets game/player fields.

1:149b0.name: enterlevel
1:149b0.evidence: Builds the map filename and draws entering caption, loads board, calls prelevel and initializes player/start state.

1:14e00.name: check_file_id
1:14e00.evidence: Compares FILE_ID.DIZ to the initialized alert text, ignoring line breaks at markers. Main calls it after the integrity diagnostic.

1:14e80.name: addhighscore
1:14e80.evidence: Uses the same quote and numeric record arrays saved in USERDEFS.TMP and displayed at 0a8b0.

1:14f80.name: gethighscore_name
1:14f80.evidence: Uses the score row to compute y, animates shade and invokes strget with a 31-character limit.

1:14fb0.name: checkcursectnums
1:14fb0.evidence: Walks connecthead/connectpoint2, compares player cursectnum and returns the matching player or -1. SECTOR.C counterpart.

1:15000.name: findplayer
1:15000.evidence: Finds nearest connected player by Manhattan distance from an input sprite's x/y, returns player index and stores distance.

1:150a0.name: doanimations
1:150a0.evidence: Updates active animation target pointers toward stored goals using signed velocities and removes completed entries.

1:15340.name: getanimationgoal
1:15340.evidence: Finds an animated address by scanning animateptr, called from sector operation logic. STRICT probe includes full 64-byte extent.

1:15380.name: setanimation
1:15380.evidence: Inserts or replaces animated pointer, sector, goal and velocity. Enforces 511 active limit.

1:15410.name: animatecamsprite
1:15410.evidence: Advances selected viewscreen/camera state and calls camera renderer at 11380.

1:15550.name: animatewalls
1:15550.evidence: Walks animwall indices, mutates wall textures and panning, and drives the water-effect helper on a tile buffer.

1:15810.name: callsound
1:15810.evidence: Searches tagged mechanism sprites and calls spritesound with the corresponding emitter.

1:159e0.name: operatesectors
1:159e0.evidence: Switches on sector lotag with lock bit removed, changes animated goal pointers and triggers mechanism sounds.

1:18210.name: operateactivators
1:18210.evidence: Walks the activator status list by hitag, toggles lock flag for ACTIVATORLOCKED and calls operatesectors for unblocked mechanisms.

1:19540.name: operatemasterswitches
1:19540.evidence: Walks sprites, checks MASTERSWITCH tile 51 from DEFS.CON and matching hitag, changes its activation field from 0 to 1.

1:19590.name: operateforcefields
1:19590.evidence: Scans animwall textures with optional tag match and changes their blocking flags. Compare SECTOR.C.

1:19720.name: checkhitswitch
1:19720.evidence: Player interaction with wall/sprite switches, tests inventory/access state and reaches tagged activation/sound logic.

1:1b4b0.name: checkhitwall
1:1b4b0.evidence: Handles impact on wall tiles including SLOTDOOR, handles tagged glass/effect breakage and plays impact audio.

1:1bb10.name: breakwall
1:1bb10.evidence: Changes a hit wall texture and uses updatesector, EGS and dragpoint with impact coordinates.

1:1c180.name: checkhitceiling
1:1c180.evidence: Checks a sector ceiling texture against WALLLIGHT tiles and changes the texture and lighting state.

1:1c5e0.name: checksectors
1:1c5e0.evidence: Player sector tag handling, exit/secret triggers and calls into sector operation and wall interaction routines.

1:1f190.name: allignwarpelevators
1:1f190.evidence: Pairs lotag 17 sector effectors of equal hitag and copies floor/ceiling heights. Spelling follows SECTOR.C.

1:1f2e0.name: aimatplayer
1:1f2e0.evidence: Computes sprite/player angle and distance, filters target geometry and tests visibility. Used by actor updates.

1:1f660.name: shoot
1:1f660.evidence: Sprite/tile arguments, sine-vector trajectory, hitscan plus hit handlers and projectile construction.

1:1fd20.name: displayweapon_overlay
1:1fd20.evidence: Called by displayweapon, uses local animation sequence at 1f280 and reads player weapon/display fields.

1:1fe40.name: displayweapon
1:1fe40.evidence: Selects first-person tiles from weapon ID, uses view motion and recoil fields, and calls the sprite drawing helper.

1:20e60.name: getinput
1:20e60.evidence: Samples keyboard/mouse and writes per-player sync movement bytes and bit masks consumed by processinput.

1:21410.name: processinput
1:21410.evidence: Consumes sync state, updates player movement and physics, calls clipmove and hitscan and dispatches weapon fire.

1:25180.name: addweapon
1:25180.evidence: Dispatches weapon tile IDs and writes per-player ownership and ammo state. Compare the corresponding ACTORS.C routine.

1:25480.name: hitradius
1:25480.evidence: Walks selected sprite status lists, checks squared radius, applies damage and may emit a quote. Compare ACTORS.C.

1:255b0.name: guts
1:255b0.evidence: Spawns status-5 debris through EGS at source position with vertical offset. Arguments and exact historical name need recovery.

1:25600.name: ssp
1:25600.evidence: Computes sprite velocity components from xvel, zvel and angle, then calls engine movesprite and tests its result.

1:25750.name: ms
1:25750.evidence: Advances a moving-sector sprite with its angle/xvel and rotates and drags its wall points. Compare ACTORS.C ms.

1:258c0.name: movefta
1:258c0.evidence: Early status-3 scan checks nearest player and line of sight before quote/sound or status transition. Compare later ACTORS.C movefta and verify the status renumbering.

1:25a60.name: ifsquished
1:25a60.evidence: Tests sector ceiling-floor gap and exemptions, reports the crushing quote and adjusts special sectors.

1:25c30.name: ifbulletnear
1:25c30.evidence: Scans status-5 sprites for a nearby non-owned projectile and returns after distance, height and classification checks.

1:25f10.name: moveactors
1:25f10.evidence: Status-2 sprite update loop handles many tile IDs, nearest-player checks and dispatches into the CON executor.

1:28f30.name: moveexplosions
1:28f30.evidence: Updates status-5 effect sprites including RADIUSEXPLOSION tile 46, then dispatches selected tiles into the CON executor.

1:294e0.name: movestandables
1:294e0.evidence: Updates status-6 sprites, including destructible props and effects, and dispatches script-driven tiles.

1:2a470.name: moveplayers
1:2a470.evidence: Walks status 11, reads the owning player's old position fields, updates representation sprites and runs player actor script.

1:2a860.name: movefx
1:2a860.evidence: Walks status 12 and dispatches music/sound effects based on tags and distance, including music volume and track selection.

1:2ab90.name: moveweapons
1:2ab90.evidence: Walks status 7, processes SEENINE and other projectile tiles, sprite collisions and CON-driven updates.

1:2ba30.name: bootleg_cache_alloc
1:2ba30.evidence: Bump allocator with Clog Error and Out of memory diagnostics, 128-entry size stack and remaining-space count.

1:2baa0.name: bootleg_cache_pop
1:2baa0.evidence: Drops the last allocation and restores cursor and free count. Three consecutive calls free compiler workspace after parsing.

1:2bae0.name: bootleg_cache_reset
1:2bae0.evidence: Unreached routine after bootleg_cache_pop and its padding, walks the outstanding size stack to unwind all allocations.

1:2bb30.name: init_bootleg_cache
1:2bb30.evidence: Called after BootLeg CacheMaster diagnostic, establishes 300000-byte arena. STRICT probe.

1:2bb60.name: USRHOOKS_GetMem
1:2bb60.evidence: ASS allocation calls at 56129, 5ab5e, 5be60 and 5d916, with out-pointer and size. STRICT under wc95b.

1:2bb90.name: USRHOOKS_FreeMem
1:2bb90.evidence: ASS cleanup calls at 56147, 5ab9b, 5be90 and 5d985. Pops cache allocation and returns zero. STRICT under wc95b.

1:2bbd0.name: loadsounds
1:2bbd0.evidence: Main calls after Reading sounds. Iterates 39 VOC names, opens and reads each into the arena.

1:2bc40.name: playmusic
1:2bc40.evidence: Loads a passed filename into a fixed buffer and calls MUSIC_PlaySong. Used on level transition and in movefx.

1:2bcb0.name: xyzsound
1:2bcb0.evidence: Uses explicit x/y arguments, calculates bearing and attenuation and calls FX_PlayVOC3D.

1:2be70.name: spritesound
1:2be70.evidence: Fetches x/y/z from a passed sprite index, calculates bearing and attenuation and calls FX_PlayVOC3D.

1:2c040.name: stopsound
1:2c040.evidence: Stops the stored ASS voice handle and decrements the corresponding active count.

1:2c090.name: pan3dsound
1:2c090.evidence: Recomputes active sound bearing and attenuation and passes the handle to the audio panning API.

1:2c190.name: TestCallBack
1:2c190.evidence: Registered via FX_SetCallBack from main and decrements the voice count by callback number. STRICT 43-byte function.

1:2c1c0.name: initmenus
1:2c1c0.evidence: Loads main/pause/episode/skill/save/options string list pointers into menu state and sets initial selection fields.

1:2c590.name: drawmenu
1:2c590.evidence: Walks menu lines and renders text and selection/cursor graphics.

1:2c6f0.name: probe
1:2c6f0.evidence: Menu keyboard/cursor selection loop with highlight drawing. Compare MENUES.C probe.

1:2ccf0.name: menus
1:2ccf0.evidence: Drives main and pause menu state, input remapping, newgame/enterlevel, loadplayer and saveplayer.

1:2e060.name: draw_fade_transition
1:2e060.evidence: Steps a transition scalar toward 0x2000 and renders a scaled tile 0x473. Descriptive name.

1:2e0d0.name: vscrn
1:2e0d0.evidence: Sets the viewing rectangle from the selected player's screen size and the 320-by-200 logical display dimensions.

1:2e120.name: init_water_ripples
1:2e120.evidence: Builds integer-radius rings with ksqrt and a palette ramp before rendering begins.

1:2e200.name: animate_water_ripples
1:2e200.evidence: Seeds random points on a 128-pixel grid and applies the precomputed ring tables to a mutable tile. Called from animatewalls.

1:2e6e0.name: resetparallax
1:2e6e0.evidence: Called before reading palette remaps, initializes a short renderer lookup table's first entry and its control word.

1:2e700.name: getincangle_shift
1:2e700.evidence: Normalizes both angles modulo 2048 and returns a shifted angular difference. Prototype differs from two-argument GAMEDEF.C getincangle.

1:2e740.name: ispecial
1:2e740.evidence: Tests LF, CR and space, incrementing the CON line counter for LF. Same behavior as GAMEDEF.C. STRICT probe.

1:2e770.name: isaltok
1:2e770.evidence: Checks CRT alphanumeric mask and seven punctuation characters in the same order as GAMEDEF.C. STRICT probe.

1:2e7b0.name: getlabel
1:2e7b0.evidence: Copies a label into a 64-byte slot while maintaining the line counter. Same loop as GAMEDEF.C. STRICT probe.

1:2e850.name: keyword
1:2e850.evidence: Scans without advancing global textptr, compares token to the 60-entry keyword table and returns index, zero at EOF or -1.

1:2e920.name: transword
1:2e920.evidence: Reads and translates a keyword into a script word and reports an undefined symbol on lookup failure. Compare GAMEDEF.C.

1:2eae0.name: transnum
1:2eae0.evidence: Matches defined-label names and parses numeric tokens with atoi; unknown token triggers the undefined-parameter diagnostic.

1:2ed60.name: parsecommand
1:2ed60.evidence: Switch-driven CON compiler with recursive include handling and state, actor and brace diagnostics.

1:301e0.name: loadefs
1:301e0.evidence: Opens GAME.CON, allocates parser buffers, compiles commands and reports lines, warning/error counts and script size.

1:303b0.name: furthestangle
1:303b0.evidence: Divides 2048 angular units by sample count and sweeps hitscan directions to find a preferred route. Compare GAMEDEF.C.

1:308b0.name: parse
1:308b0.evidence: Recursive bytecode instruction dispatcher with executing CON instruction pointer and actor/action/sound helpers.

1:32260.name: execute
1:32260.evidence: Looks up per-tile actor code, seeds execution context and runs actor script plus movement logic. Compare GAMEDEF.C execute.

1:33e5c.name: keyhandler
1:33e5c.evidence: First engine C entry. Engine init at 3a263 references its address, and it updates keystatus via IRQ1 keyboard ports and iretd.

2:00004.name: beta_exit_banner
2:00004.evidence: Printed during gameexit. A second copy at 2:0032c is used by main.

2:02304.name: bonus_tile_ids
2:02304.evidence: Short sequences indexed by dobonus for tile selection.

2:02364.name: player_animation_frames
2:02364.evidence: Frame selectors indexed by weapon display and player input code, with 0xff terminators.

2:023dc.name: highscore_quotes
2:023dc.evidence: 12 records of 33 bytes. Byte-equal to USERDEFS.TMP[21:417] and rendered by displayhighscores.

2:02568.name: highscore_values
2:02568.evidence: 12 dwords. Byte-equal to the last 48 bytes of USERDEFS.TMP and used with the score quotes.

2:02598.name: fta_quotes
2:02598.evidence: FTA indexes this table in 32-byte slots. Messages cover help, events and sector triggers.

2:02738.name: scantoasc
2:02738.evidence: 128-entry unshifted DOS scancode-to-character table used by strget.

2:027b8.name: scantoascwithshift
2:027b8.evidence: 128-entry shifted scancode table used by strget alongside 2:02738.

2:02838.name: sound_names
2:02838.evidence: 39 pointer fixups into the VOC pool. loadsounds loops over exactly 0x9c bytes.

2:028d4.name: sound_device_names
2:028d4.evidence: Nine device-name pointers into the pool at 08a4-0928.

2:028f8.name: sound_device_map
2:028f8.evidence: Nine dwords translating setup device selection to ASS device IDs during startup.

2:0291c.name: file_id_expected
2:0291c.evidence: check_file_id compares 400 expected positions against FILE_ID.DIZ, treating '*' as end-of-line markers.

2:02b10.name: keyw
2:02b10.evidence: 60 relocated pointers into the keyword string pool at 0b44-0d8c. Lexical lookup compares 0xf0 bytes of entries.

2:02cda.name: default_keys
2:02cda.evidence: loadtables copies 17 fallback scancodes from here to 1bde84. The supplied SETUP.DAT overrides the fifth default and has the same other 16 bytes.

2:02e7a.name: myconnectindex
2:02e7a.evidence: Engine network routines set it and game call sites index the local player, inputs and connection state by it.

2:0ac50.name: oldtimerhandler
2:0ac50.evidence: Six-byte old IRQ0 far pointer, fills offset at ac50 and selector at ac54 from _dos_getvect. Restored on exit.

2:0ac56.name: output_dir
2:0ac56.evidence: Filled from /oDIR, used later by file paths. Next independently referenced byte is ac60.

2:0ae78.name: actorscrptr
2:0ae78.evidence: loadefs clears 4096 dwords at 30299 and parsecommand stores per-tile script pointers here. execute and spawn read by picnum.

2:0eec8.name: animatevel
2:0eec8.evidence: 512 signed long velocities, setanimation writes from its fourth argument and doanimations multiplies by elapsed ticks.

2:0f6c8.name: recsyncsvel
2:0f6c8.evidence: First 16384-byte demo array by address. Captures the byte from a53bb, interpreted as sideways velocity.

2:136c8.name: recsyncangvel
2:136c8.evidence: Second 16384-byte demo array by address. Captures the byte from a53dd, interpreted as angular velocity.

2:176c8.name: script_end
2:176c8.evidence: loadefs saves scriptptr after parsecommand finishes, then uses it in the code-size diagnostic.

2:176cc.name: script
2:176cc.evidence: Script emission starts here. Inferred allocation ceiling 2:1d6d8 from the next independently bound array, with no observed bounds check.

2:1d6d8.name: recsyncbits
2:1d6d8.evidence: 16384 dwords of recorded command masks. read_demo reads four times the frame count into this array.

2:2d6d8.name: recsynctics
2:2d6d8.evidence: 16384 per-frame timing bytes copied from the simulation tick increment.

2:316d8.name: recsyncvel
2:316d8.evidence: 16384 bytes from a53ff, interpreted as forward velocity. The serializer writes this byte stream first.

2:356d8.name: sound_file_table
2:356d8.evidence: 39 eight-byte entries initialized by loadsounds. First dword points to cached VOC payload and is passed to FX_PlayVOC3D.

2:35810.name: music_buffer
2:35810.evidence: playmusic reads an entire MIDI file here and passes this pointer to MUSIC_PlaySong. Next established base is 3f450.

2:3f450.name: bootleg_cache
2:3f450.evidence: Arena base and 300000-byte size in init_bootleg_cache. Ends exactly at player array base 88830.

2:88830.name: ps
2:88830.evidence: 17 slots at 176 bytes each up to 893e0. Indexes connected players and holds sprite IDs, positions, sectors and inventory.

2:893e0.name: hittype
2:893e0.evidence: 4096 per-sprite entries at 20-byte stride up to 9d3e0. spawn, moveactors and CON code use it for hit and runtime metadata.

2:9d3e0.name: keyboard_text_fifo
2:9d3e0.evidence: Keyboard IRQ processing and strget share this queue. Element format and length still open.

2:a1430.name: animatesect
2:a1430.evidence: 512 shorts. setanimation records its sector argument at the same index as animateptr and animategoal.

2:a1830.name: animateptr
2:a1830.evidence: 512 pointers up to a2030. setanimation stores target pointers, doanimations dereferences them and getanimationgoal searches them.

2:a2030.name: animategoal
2:a2030.evidence: 512 target dwords. doanimations adjusts the referenced value toward the corresponding entry.

2:a4830.name: tempbuf
2:a4830.evidence: Shared CLI, FILE_ID, network and CON token scratch. Binary use proves at least 450 bytes; exact allocation length open.

2:a4c30.name: animwall
2:a4c30.evidence: Six-byte entries indexed by prelevel and animatewalls, with wall number at +0 and changing texture/tag fields.

2:a5230.name: textptr
2:a5230.evidence: CON file cursor set from file-content allocation and advanced by token and label routines.

2:a5234.name: insptr
2:a5234.evidence: Interpreted instruction pointer, advanced by parse and seeded by execute from the per-tile script table.

2:a5238.name: labelcnt
2:a5238.evidence: Index incremented as labels are defined, scales by 64 in text table and four in value table.

2:a523c.name: label
2:a523c.evidence: Pointer to the 32 KiB, 64-byte-per-label compile-time table.

2:a5244.name: labelcode
2:a5244.evidence: Pointer to the 2 KiB compile-time label-value table. transnum reads it after a label match.

2:a524c.name: scriptptr
2:a524c.evidence: Compiler output cursor initialized at 176cc. Tracks dword emissions in parsecommand.

2:a5250.name: animatecnt
2:a5250.evidence: Active sector-animation count capped at 511 by setanimation.

2:a5254.name: reccnt
2:a5254.evidence: 32-bit demo frame count, read and written in header and advanced by record.

2:a5258.name: recstat
2:a5258.evidence: Demo recording mode flag tested by record and write_demo. Compare Ken GAME.C.

2:a52a0.name: syncbits
2:a52a0.evidence: Per-player command masks recorded as dwords and tested by input/simulation routines.

2:a538c.name: screenpeek
2:a538c.evidence: Display and panning routines select the viewed player slot with this index.

2:a53a8.name: numanimwalls
2:a53a8.evidence: prelevel increments it when assigning animated walls; animatewalls bounds its loop by it.

2:a5420.name: sound_voices
2:a5420.evidence: 39 packed 19-byte records inferred up to a5705. x/y +0/+4, emitter +12, handle +14, voice count +18.

2:a5708.name: menu_descriptors
2:a5708.evidence: Repeated 16-byte descriptors populated by initmenus and consumed by menus; text and selection/end fields.

2:a57a8.name: user_settings
2:a57a8.evidence: First 21 bytes of USERDEFS.TMP loaded here. Fields include quote enable, audio enable and mouse sensitivity.

2:a57bd.name: warning
2:a57bd.evidence: CON warning counter incremented from duplicate definition branches and passed to summary printf.

2:a57be.name: error
2:a57be.evidence: CON error counter incremented from invalid syntax branches and tested before entering game.

2:a57c1.name: synctics
2:a57c1.evidence: Simulation tick delta recorded in recsynctics and used to advance elapsed game clock.

2:a57d0.name: cache_sizes
2:a57d0.evidence: 128 dwords from a57d0 to a59d0; each allocation records its size before incrementing stack depth.

2:a59d0.name: cache_depth
2:a59d0.evidence: Counts allocations on game LIFO memory stack.

2:a59d4.name: cache_remaining
2:a59d4.evidence: Remaining arena bytes set to 300000 by initializer.

2:a59e0.name: ripple_ages
2:a59e0.evidence: Per-ripple counters indexed with parallel random coordinate arrays during water-tile update.

2:a5a20.name: ripple_palette
2:a5a20.evidence: 128-byte ramp initialized by 2e120 and used by water tile renderer.

2:a5ae0.name: ripple_ring_x
2:a5ae0.evidence: Base inferred from radius times 512 and first 1-based slot at a5ae0; stores integer x offsets grouped by radius.

2:a9ae0.name: ripple_ring_y
2:a9ae0.evidence: Parallel radius table of y offsets, inferred from writer at 2e15d.

2:b1df0.name: text_end
2:b1df0.evidence: Stores the last usable position in the CON source buffer before compilation.

2:b1df6.name: line_number
2:b1df6.evidence: Incremented on LF, saved per include and printed in line-numbered diagnostics.

2:b1df8.name: total_lines
2:b1df8.evidence: Accumulates included-file lines, then adds root script line_number for summary display.

2:11eb90.name: waloff
2:11eb90.evidence: 4096 dword tile pointers set by loader and used by rendering, precache and dynamic tile updates.

2:12ed90.name: nextspritestat
2:12ed90.evidence: 4096 short links indexed by sprite ID and traversed by each sprite-status loop.

2:134d90.name: gotpic
2:134d90.evidence: 4096-bit tile-use bitmap cleared by loadboard and set by spawn/render code with tile ID shifted by three.

2:13a410.name: pskyoff
2:13a410.evidence: Renderer reads a short offset table indexed for parallax tiles. First entry is reset to zero before loading remaps.

2:13ba10.name: sintable
2:13ba10.evidence: 2048 short values loaded from TABLES.DAT. Game uses 0x7ff phase mask and +512 quadrant offset.

2:13ca10.name: keystatus
2:13ca10.evidence: 256 byte flags populated by keyboard IRQ and consumed by timer, menu and text entry.

2:13cf10.name: extra
2:13cf10.evidence: Map v5 loadboard reads 10-byte extra records. 4096 records fit exactly before sprite at 146f10.

2:146f10.name: sprite
2:146f10.evidence: 4096 packed 38-byte map and runtime sprites up to sector. loadboard reads each record directly.

2:16cf10.name: sector
2:16cf10.evidence: 1024 packed 37-byte sectors up to wall. loadboard reads these at 3922a.

2:176310.name: wall
2:176310.evidence: 8192 packed 35-byte walls up to 1bc310. loadboard reads these at 39271.

2:1bce28.name: totalclock
2:1bce28.evidence: Incremented by the PIT timer and used for display timing, tick scheduling and elapsed time.

2:1bd63c.name: headspritestat
2:1bd63c.evidence: Engine list initialization writes status heads here; game loops select fixed status offsets and follow nextspritestat.

2:1bde7e.name: pskybits
2:1bde7e.evidence: Short initialized to three and used by renderer alongside the parallax offset table.

2:1bde80.name: numwalls
2:1bde80.evidence: 16-bit count read before the 35-byte wall records.

2:1bde82.name: numsectors
2:1bde82.evidence: 16-bit count read before the 37-byte sector records.

2:1bde84.name: keys
2:1bde84.evidence: loadtables reads SETUP.DAT bytes 6 to 22 here or copies fallback defaults. Keyboard and timer code consume the scancodes.

2:1be134.name: connectpoint2
2:1be134.evidence: Per-player short next links followed by both game and network code.

2:1bedb4.name: numplayers
2:1bedb4.evidence: Engine network init sets the player count and defaults it to one at 47bd6. Multiplayer teardown checks whether this word is greater than one.

2:1bedb8.name: connecthead
2:1bedb8.evidence: Starting connected-player index used by checkcursectnums, findplayer and game tick loops.
